sourceFile: 24.BRS161016 GMI Report test VP new lot_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not verifiable because it merges distinct VP lot-date reports and misstates the changed factor.
issues: Separate lot-date reports are merged under one 27.02.2026 case.
Changed factor wrongly uses mold list instead of lot/new-vs-old context.
Baseline is explicit only for sheet 13.3; other sheets are new-lot checks.
Outcomes mix sheets, dates, lots, and molds without grouping keys.
Measurement outcomes are header/title artifacts, not valid evidence.
correctionPlan: Split review cases by report sheet or lot date.
For 13.3, model old lot VP #3/#12 versus new lot VP #3/#6/#10.
For other sheets, keep new lot date and mold as subgroup context unless a baseline is cited.
Keep SUB1 and function outcomes within each same sheet/report context.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient for final evidence.
